strings.이리스… 오지 말아요… 오면 안돼…!: Iris... Don't come... You mustn't come...!
strings.아앗! 이리스, 저기 하늘을 봐! 게네페야!: Ah! Iris, look up at the sky! It's Genepe!
strings.마왕의 목표는 데르족의 혈통에 숨어있는 강대한 <힘>…: The Demon King seeks the immense <power> hidden in the Tyr bloodline...
strings.!! 마왕이 지금 위그드라실에 머물러 있다는 건…: !! If the Demon King is in Yggdrasil now...
strings.………흥, 마왕이네 뭐네 하지만 하는 짓은 하찮군 그래?: ...Hmph. Demon King or whatever he calls himself, his methods are pathetic.
strings.그럼 게네페, 당신이 마왕에게 잡혀있는 것은…: Then, Genepe, the reason the Demon King has captured you is...
strings.…아아아아… 너무… 너무 괴로워… 제발… 도와줘요…!: ...Aaaaah... It hurts... It hurts so much... Please... Help me...!
strings.아니… 아니야… 오면 안돼… 아아아!: No... No... You mustn't come... Aaaah!
Ugh... H-he looks like he's in so much pain... Ngh...
strings.마, 마음을 굳게 먹어야 한대이. 무웬!: S-steady yourself, Muwen! You have to be strong!
strings.……………용서할 수 없어.\n기다려요, 게네페! 반드시 구해주겠어…!!:
...I will never forgive this.
Hold on, Genepe! I'll save you, no matter what...!
Ah... No, Iris. Run away. Please...
strings.데르족의 소년… 저희에게 경고를 하기 위해, 최후의 힘을 다한 듯 합니다: The Tyr boy... It seems he used the last of his strength to warn us.
strings.………………………\n무웬… 여기서 돌아가주지 않을래?:
...
Muwen... Would you turn back here?
strings.응? 무슨 소리야?: Huh? What are you talking about?
strings.이건 제 싸움이에요. 무웬은… 그리고… 다른 분들도…. 더 이상 위험한: This is my fight. Muwen... And... all of you... You don't need to join me in any more dangerous battles...
strings.마… 말도 안되는 소리 하지마 이리스! 여기까지 주욱 함께였잖아!: D-don't be ridiculous, Iris! We've been together all this way!
strings.하모. 이제 와서 그런 걱정은 할 필요가 없다카이. 여짝까졍 와서 니 싸: Exactly. No need to start worrying about that now. After coming this far, what's yours and what's ours? You'll be in trouble without Muwen and me when you face the Demon King!
strings.내가 없으면 매사가 대충대충, 늦잠꾸러기에, 박치에 음치에다, 요리도 못: Without me, you do everything halfheartedly, sleep late, can't keep a beat or carry a tune, can't cook... Honestly, you're hopeless as an adult! How could I leave you alone? Ahem!
strings.무웬이 언니 노릇을 톡톡~히 하는구마~~: Muwen's doing a fine job as your big sister!
strings.에… 사회인 실격… \n자, 잠깐! 거기 박치니 음치니는 왜 나오는거야!:
Oh... Hopeless as an adult...
W-wait! What do my singing and rhythm have to do with this?!
strings.후후, 하긴 꼬맹이를 처음 만났을 때 춤추던 모습은 정말…: Hehe. True, the way the little one danced when we first met was really...
strings.아, 레비씨 웃었다아. 오랜만에 보는걸~: Oh, Mr. Levi smiled! It's been a while since I saw that!
strings.이리스님, 여기까지 함께 온 일행들 중… 마왕과의 싸움에 빠질 사람은 없: Lady Iris, not one of the companions who has come this far with you will sit out the battle against the Demon King.
Exactly. No fool would miss an event like this. It's surely once in a lifetime.
strings.하찮게 내 시간을 낭비하지 마. 이러고 있을때도 저 게네페란 아이는 고통: Stop wasting my time with this nonsense. While we're standing here, that boy Genepe is still suffering, isn't he?
strings.…!! 그래요, 그렇죠.\n알았어요, 더 이상 말하지 않겠습니다.\n여러:
...! Yes. You're right.
All right. I won't say any more.
Thank you, everyone. Truly.
strings.…그럼… 가죠! 위그드라실로! \n마왕을 물리칩시다!:
...Then... let's go! To Yggdrasil!
Let's defeat the Demon King!
Understood. Before that... We should find Lord Siam, whom we became separated from.
Hmph! Always such a slow child.
strings.결국… 오고야… 말겠다는 거군요?: So... in the end... you insist on coming?
strings.…………그래야지. 이리스는 착하니까. 후후후…: ...Of course you do. Iris is a good girl. Hehehe...
Hehehe...
It's been a long road, but at last we've come this far.
Now that she's come this far, it's over. That girl is as good as in my hands.
I don't need a doll like you anymore.
strings.모든 일을 확실히 끝내려면, 완전한 [절망] 을 안겨줘서, 저항의 의지를: To finish everything with certainty, I must give her complete [despair] and break her will to resist.
strings.…그래.\n이리스, 그 아이에게 간절하게 찾고 있던, 살아남은 유일한 동:
...Yes.
Iris, that girl... The sole surviving member of her people whom she has searched for so desperately, [Genepe]...
strings.실은 내가 이리스의 유전자를 이용해서 만들어낸, 살아서 숨을 쉴 뿐, 지: If I tell her he's really a [doll] I created using Iris's own genes—a mere shell that lives and breathes, with neither intelligence nor a heart...
...Then Iris will truly fall into utter despair.
...Hmph. In that case, I'll postpone disposing of this doll until then.
strings.………이게… 뭐야… 이게 뭐냐구…!!\n마왕을 물리치면 모두가 행복해지는:
...What... is this...? What is this...?!
Wasn't everyone supposed to be happy once we defeated the Demon King?
strings.이리스가 마왕에게 최후의 일격을 날리고, 둘이 무언가 대화를 하는 동안,:
Iris dealt the Demon King the final blow. As the two of them exchanged words, an enormous, beautiful bird appeared in the air...
The moment it landed on his shoulder, everything changed.
strings.사악하지만 정순한 어둠 그 자체였던 마왕의 힘이 <비뚤어지고>\n그 전과:
The Demon King's power, which had been evil yet pure darkness itself, became <twisted>.
It struck us with a viciousness beyond anything before it...
Before I lost consciousness, I saw powerful beings appearing one by one from empty space...
Every one of them seemed to possess power to rival the Demon King...
strings.…초엔… 너는 일이 이렇게 될 줄 알고 있었던 거야?\n이리스가 하는 일:
...Choen... Did you know it would come to this?
Did you try to stop Iris because you knew her actions would ultimately ruin the world?
If so, why... Why did you bear it all alone...?
...I don't understand...
strings.하나 분명한 것은…\n 모두… 모든 것이… 이리스… 때문이라는 것…!\n:
One thing is clear...
All of it... Everything... is because of... Iris...!
Urgh... I won't forgive her...
Never! I'll never forgive her!
strings.………\n마왕을 물리쳤다…고 생각한 순간,\n온 세상의 아가슈라들이 바로:
...
The moment I thought we'd defeated the Demon King, I felt as though every Agasura in the world was laughing in my ear...
strings.다시 눈을 뜬 마왕은… 그 이전에는 없었던 '흉측함'… '광기'와… 격렬: When the Demon King opened his eyes again... there was a hideousness that hadn't been there before... madness... and fierce mockery... He was no longer the Demon King we'd fought, but something else... something I'd met somewhere before... A gaze as though looking at an insect... Ah... I don't know...
strings.마왕이 저로 인해 힘을 잃은 순간, 모든 것이 변했어요.\n갑자기 하늘이:
The moment the Demon King lost his power because of me, everything changed.
The sky suddenly tore open... Darkness split apart, and more darkness seeped through...
strings.여기 저기 나타난 빛나는 존재들…\n하나하나가 모두 마왕… 아니, '신':
Radiant beings appeared everywhere...
Each one like a Demon King... No, closer to a god...
strings.우리 세계의 마왕이 힘을 잃은 순간… 외부 세계로부터 지엔디아를 차단하던:
The moment our world's Demon King lost his power... the wall separating Jiendia from the worlds beyond vanished. Everything lurking in that outer darkness began to look upon our world... with hungry eyes.
Ah...
strings.……\n무웬과 조에는 괜찮을까? 흑월공주님은… 레비님이 지켜주셨으니 괜찮:
...
Are Muwen and Zoe all right? The Dark Moon Princess... Lord Levi protected her, so she should be safe...
strings.하지만 대신 레비님은 죽어버렸어….\n게네페… 게네페도…\n그리고… 카즈:
But Lord Levi died in her place...
Genepe... Genepe, too...
And... Kazno...
strings.…\n카즈노는… 괜찮아… \n응… 그래…… 분명 마지막에…\n:
...
Kazno is... all right...
Yes... That's right... At the very end, he definitely...
...I... think... I'm going to lose my mind...
strings.눈물…?\n아… 안돼… 나, 난, 울어서는 안돼.\n내겐 자신을 동정할:
Tears...?
Ah... No... I-I mustn't cry.
I have no right... to pity myself.
What I've done... I have to take responsibility...
strings.…아… 하지만 어떻게… 무엇을…?\n할머니… 나 어쩌면 좋아요?:
...Ah... But how...? What can I...?
Grandmother... What should I do?
strings.아가슈라. \n아가슈라는 다른 세계에서 온 유배자. 커다란 죄를 짓고 자:
Agasura.
The Agasura are exiles from other worlds. They committed grave sins and were banished from their own worlds to Jiendia... Beings forced to live as monsters.
strings.즉, 우리의 [악함] 은 천성적인 것이 아니라.. 이 세계가 우리에게 마: In other words, our [evil] is not innate... This world forces us to live as monsters... as [darkness].
strings.데르족의 피에 흐르는 천부적인 힘…. 그것은 아가슈라를 물리치도록 데르족: The innate power flowing in the Tyr's blood... It was given to them to defeat the Agasura. Yet their gentle nature meant they could not stand against us.
When her grandmother and ... died, leaving Iris alone... all the destiny bestowed upon the Tyr began to gather in that one girl.
strings.그런 무거운 부담을 지고 여행을 떠나, 기쁘고 슬픈 많은 일들을 겪었지만: She set out carrying that terrible burden and experienced so much joy and sorrow... Yet it never twisted her. She truly was a good girl.
strings.울보고, 잘 화내고, 멋대로이고, 하지만 잔인한 운명을 받아들여 세상을: A crybaby, quick to anger, willful... Yet this affectionate child accepted her cruel fate and resolved to save the world. I... did not dislike her.
strings.나는, 고향은 서로 다르지만, 비열한 운명의 굴레에 한데 묶인 형제들의: I am the eldest brother of those who, though born in different homelands, are bound together by the same vile fate. I am one of the leaders of the Agasura.
strings.우리들을 구속하는 운명의 제어자인… [마왕]을 극복하기 위하여, 나는 초: To overcome the [Demon King], who governs the fate that binds us, I joined Choen Palm's plan... and betrayed Iris!
strings.아가슈라의 모든 행위에는 그 근간에 [악] 이 자리잡아야 하며… 그렇지: Every act of an Agasura must be rooted in [evil]... Otherwise, punishment is inflicted upon the one responsible—sometimes even erasure.
strings.어둡고, 악하여, 마침내 빛의 손에 멸하게 될 운명인 존재가 아가슈라.\:
The Agasura are dark, evil beings, destined to perish at the hands of light.
So if I act wickedly, it is natural, something this world itself endorses.
strings.그렇기에 이리스를 배신하는 것은… 너무나도 쉬웠다. 숙명에 벗어나기 위해: That is why betraying Iris... was so very easy. The irony of embracing destiny to escape it... Laughable.
Only now, with my goal achieved... does true revulsion wash over me.
strings....이리스는 살아남았다.\n다른 세계에서 온 사이암이라는 애송이.\n그:
...Iris survived.
That young fool from another world, Siam...
He did not hesitate for even an instant at my proposal.
strings.[아가슈라의 계약] 은 맺어지고, 그는 이리스를 죽음에서 구해냈다.\n그:
The [Agasura's contract] was made, and he saved Iris from death.
At the time, I felt a little comforted too.
strings.하지만 지금, 위그드라실 저편에서 나에게까지 전해져 오는 이 격렬하고도: But now, this fierce, dark emotion reaches even me from beyond Yggdrasil. It is... Iris's despair.
Lacking the courage to face her, I intend to make one gamble with little chance of success.
strings....아스가르드에서 지상으로 떨어지는 빛의 파편들이 보이는군.\n저것은:
...I can see fragments of light falling from Asgard to the earth.
Those are Memorials. Stones that take intense emotions, memories, and wishes into themselves.
It is not merely sentiment that makes them look like her tears.
Such faint, flickering hope falls upon the earth... So very faint... a hope.
strings.이 세상에서, 나는 이제 자유다.\n그럼 이제… 어디로 가야 하나?:
In this world, I am now free.
Then... where should I go?
strings.(탑의 정상에는 제이드 대신 사이암이 기다리고 있었다): (At the top of the tower, Siam is waiting in Jade's place.)
There is no time for a long discussion.
strings.(사이암은 지팡이를 들어 구름 저편에 떠 있는 섬을 가리킨다.): (Siam raises his staff and points to an island floating beyond the clouds.)
I am ready to transport you there. Prepare yourself.
strings.마왕과의 싸움에서 받은 저주의 일환으로 평범한 세계로로는 돌아갈 수 없게: A curse from the battle with the Demon King prevents me from returning to the ordinary world... But this is no longer an ordinary dimension.
strings.바나헤임... 애초에 원래의 세계와 분리되어 불완전했던 이 세계는 천천히: Vanaheim... Separated from its original world and incomplete from the start, this realm is slowly collapsing.
strings.불꽃의 새가, 그리고 그 뒤를 쫓아 외부세계의 사람들이 들어옴으로써, 오: The bird of flame entered, followed by people from the outside world. Their arrival weakened the ancient barrier.
That allowed me to come here and hear the situation from the mage called Jade.
strings....그대를 보내고 나면, 나는 이 곳이 이대로 붕괴되는 것을 막아볼 생: ...Once I have sent you onward, I will try to prevent this place from collapsing.
strings.이 장소에 가득한 어둠의 힘이 흘러넘쳐, 수많은 차원을 오염시키지 않도록: So that the darkness filling it does not spill out and corrupt countless dimensions.
The other half of this little world, I imagine.
The storm-filled vortex, the powerful barrier guarding the island, the island resting above them...
In all of it, I sense the same power Iris possessed.
What lies above is likely a legacy left by the Tyr.
See for yourself what it is.
strings.3. 불꽃의 새도 저 곳에?: 3. Is the bird of flame there too?
strings.틀림없소. 이 자리에 서고보니, 하늘 저편에서 그 존재감이 확연히 느껴지: Without a doubt. Standing here, I can clearly sense its presence beyond the sky.
But it is greatly weakened. In its current state, it should be unable to resist you.
strings.제이드 오르 펠릭스. 괜찮은 인재더군. 정진하면 훌륭한 마법사가 될 것이: Jade Or Felix. A promising talent. With diligence, a fine mage will emerge.
Jade has gone to prepare what I requested: materials and people.
strings.그가 잘 해준다면 바나헤임은 소멸하지 않고, 다른 차원들의 안전도 지켜지: If that goes well, Vanaheim will not vanish, and the other dimensions will remain safe.
strings.시공마법의 힘을 담은 반지요. 이것으로 마법의 소용돌이 저편에 있는 곳에: A ring containing the power of spacetime magic. With it, you can reach the place beyond the magical vortex.
The magic in this ring is also connected to me.
Through it, you can receive my magical power.
strings.(반지에서 알 수 없는 기분이 든다.): (The ring gives you an unfamiliar feeling.)
...Now, I must prepare the magic to sustain this world.
strings.(사이암은 가벼운 몸짓으로 탑에서 뛰어내려 떠나갔다.): (With a light movement, Siam leaps from the tower and departs.)
strings.(퀘스트 완료 후 반지를 끼고, 스킬창을 살펴보자.): (After completing the quest, equip the ring and check the skill window.)
strings.(약간의 어지러움이 느껴진다 싶더니, 어느새 숲 한가운데에 서 있다.): (A brief wave of dizziness passes. Before you know it, you are standing in the middle of a forest.)
strings.(한 밤중의 숲. 그러나 어둡지 않다.): (A forest at midnight. Yet it is not dark.)
strings.(이 곳에 드리워진 밤도, 영원히 걷히지 않을 것만 같다.): (The night hanging over this place seems as though it will never lift.)
(In that respect it resembles the land below, but the scenery is entirely different.)
strings.(아름다운 밤하늘에 별이 총총하고, 그 빛을 받은 호수가 은빛으로 빛난다: (Stars fill the beautiful night sky, and a lake shines silver beneath their light. Did the land below once look like this, before darkness corrupted it?)
strings.(하지만 당장이라도 사라질듯한 허무한 감각이 느껴진다.): (Yet there is a hollow feeling, as though it could disappear at any moment.)
strings.(숲에서 느껴지는 고요함에는 타락한 어둠도, 악의도 느껴지지 않지만, 덧: (The forest's stillness holds neither corrupted darkness nor malice. Even so, it feels fleeting and uneasy.)
strings.(어쩐지 이 곳은 제나디아에서 만난 소녀를 떠오르게 한다.): (Somehow, this place reminds you of the girl you met in Xenadia.)
strings.(숲의 깊은 곳, 거대한 나무곁에 한 여인이 서 있다.): (Deep in the forest, a woman stands beside an enormous tree.)
strings.(석탑에서 본 영상의 소녀이다. 좀 더 나이가 들었지만 분명하다.): (It is the girl from the vision at the stone monument. She is a little older, but there is no mistaking her.)
So Vanaheim's barrier... has been destroyed after all.
strings.이 사람은... 아니야, 이 사람에게선 그런 사악한 기운이 느껴지지 않아: This person... No. I sense no such evil presence from this one.
strings.(여인은 생각에 잠겨있다 깜짝 놀란 듯 이쪽을 바라본다.): (The woman, lost in thought, turns toward you as though startled.)
Oh, forgive me. I was speaking to myself.
I cannot remember how long it has been since a true guest came here.
strings.여행자여, 바나헤임에 온 것을 환영하오. 나의 이름은 데르, 이 땅의 마: Traveler, welcome to Vanaheim. My name is Tyr. I am the last inhabitant of this land.
strings.왜 놀란 표정을 짓는거지, 여행자여? 무언가 사연이 있는 것인가?: Why do you look so surprised, Traveler? Is there some story behind it?
Come closer... I would like to hear your tale.
strings.(앞으로 나아가려 하자 보이지 않는 힘이 밀어낸다.): (When you try to move forward, an invisible force pushes you back.)
Someone has erected a barrier to prevent passage beyond this point.
strings.누가, 왜 그대의 앞길을 막는진 모르겠지만, 이건 힘으로는 돌파할 수 없: I do not know who is barring your path, or why. But you cannot break through this by force.
To dispel this barrier... you will need the Dark Moon Princess's help.
strings.흑월성의 일족이 대대로 가지고 있는 힘... 이 결계는 그것에 반응하게: The power inherited through the line of Dark Moon Castle... This barrier has been made to respond to it.
strings.(흑월공주는 호수의 수면을 바라보고 있다.): (The Dark Moon Princess is gazing at the lake.)
Mage, you're watching, aren't you? Show yourself.
strings.나만이 부술 수 있는 결계가 있다, 그러니 도움이 필요하다고?: There is a barrier that only I can break, so you need my help?
strings.이상한 이야기네. 바나헤임? 고대에 봉인된 지엔디아의 일부라고? 그런 구: What a strange story. Vanaheim? A part of Jiendia sealed away in ancient times? Why would something connected to me be in such a remote place?
strings.결계의 안쪽에 있는게 나와 관련이 있는걸까? 그래... 그렇겠지?: Is whatever lies inside the barrier connected to me? Yes... It must be, mustn't it?
You know, don't you? What waits there.
strings.그대들이 말한 '불꽃의 새'... 그래, 나도 마왕과의 싸움에서 그걸 보: That bird of flame you mentioned... Yes, I saw it in the battle with the Demon King.
And now I know what it really is...
...Her eyes were so cold when I met her in Valhalla.
I realized that all the years we'd shared, since our first meeting in Aoich, had been a lie.
strings.내 투정에 난처하게 웃던 미소도, 아메와 셋이 장난치며 깔깔대던 시간도,: Her awkward smile when I complained, the times we played and laughed with Ame, the lullabies she sang as gently as my late mother... All of it.
I can't forgive her. But I won't help you hurt her, either.
%s, you've helped me so much. I'm sorry to say this, but...
...I want nothing more to do with her.
strings.(어느새 그림자 닌자왕과 텐구가 나타나 그녀의 뒤를 지킨다.): (At some point, the Shadow Ninja King and Tengu have appeared behind her, standing guard.)
...There seems little point in trying to persuade her further.
strings.공주님의 말씀을 못 들으셨나요? 알현은 여기까지입니다. 무엄하다! 랄까요: Didn't you hear the princess? This audience is over. Such insolence! ...Or something like that?
strings.정말 죄송하지만, 이 이상 공주님의 마음을 어지럽히면 가신으로서 의무를: I'm truly sorry, but if you trouble the princess's heart any further, I will have no choice but to perform my duty as her retainer...
strings.(난처한 듯 웃고 있지만 오늘의 닌자왕은 조금 진지한 것 같다....): (He smiles awkwardly, but the Ninja King seems a little more serious than usual today...)
strings.이런이런... 어쩔 수 없군요. 각오하시길!: Oh dear... It can't be helped, then. Prepare yourself!
strings.이야, 살았습니다. 이기지도 못할 싸움은 질색이거든요. 하지만 개그를 칠: Whew, saved! I hate fights I can't win. But now I've lost a chance to make a joke?!
strings.[흐음, 그대, 내가 조언을 조금 해주도록 하지.]: [Hmm. Let me offer you a little advice.]
strings.[분명 그 결계라는 것의 안쪽에 있는 것은 불꽃 병아리겠지.]: [The one behind that barrier must be the fiery little chick.]
strings.[병아리는 아마 그 곳에 도착하기 전에 이미 만신창이가 되어있던 모양이다: [The chick was probably already in a dreadful state before arriving there.]
strings.[심안으로 그쪽 땅을 바라보니, 여기저기에 병아리의 혼의 파편이 흩어져: [Looking at that land with my mind's eye, I can see fragments of the chick's soul scattered everywhere.]
strings.[피흘린 영혼의 일부가, 그대들이 말하는 메모리움이라는 돌에 깃든게 아닐: [Perhaps pieces of that bleeding soul lodged in the stones you call Memorium. Such stones become Memorials, do they not?]
strings.[그것을 찾아보면 어쩌면, 공주의 마음을 돌이킬 수 있는 무언가 단서가: [If you find them, perhaps there will be some clue that can change the princess's mind.]
strings.[공주는 저렇게 말을 하지만, 나는 알고 있지. 그 병아리의 마음에 결코: [The princess may speak that way, but I know. The chick's heart was never made of lies alone.]
strings.[하하, 저도 동감입니다. 만약 그렇지 않았다면 이 영감탱이가 진작에 초: [Haha, I agree. If it had been, this old geezer would have roasted Choen Palm long ago, wouldn't he?]
strings.[...이놈이 이젠 전음에도 끼어드는구나?! 개그캐릭터라 재주도 좋군?: [...Now you're intruding on telepathy too?! Quite a talent, even for a comic-relief character! Who are you calling an old geezer?!]
strings.(텐구가 닌자왕을 밟기 시작했다...): (Tengu begins stomping on the Ninja King...)
strings.(텐구의 말을 따라, 초엔 팜의 메모리얼을 찾아보기로 했다.): (You decide to follow Tengu's advice and look for Choen Palm's Memorials.)
strings.후아! 역시 주인공 답군요. 진심으로 싸우는 저에게도 이건 좀 벅찬걸요?: Whew! A worthy protagonist indeed! Even fighting seriously, this is a bit much for me! Though the real reason may be Lord Tengu's halfhearted assistance!
strings.하지만 오늘의 저는 공주님을 위하여 목숨을 아끼지 않는 충직한 신하, 여: But today I am a loyal servant who will gladly lay down his life for the princess. I have no intention of yielding!
strings.(훗, 오늘의 나는 정말 멋지군, 그동안 준비했던 엘레강트한 포즈를 전부: (Heh, I really am magnificent today. I'll show off every elegant pose I've been practicing!)
strings.옛, 공주님! 공주님의 츠키카게, 여기 있습니다!: Yes, Princess! Your Tsukikage is here!
strings.(찌그러진 닌자왕을 옆으로 굴려놓고 텐구가 다가왔다.): (Tengu rolls the crumpled Ninja King aside and approaches.)
strings.(흑월공주는 건네준 메모리얼을 잠자코 받아들었다.): (The Dark Moon Princess silently accepts the Memorial you offer.)
strings.(눈을 감은 그녀의 손 안에서 메모리얼이 희미한 빛을 내기 시작한다.): (She closes her eyes. The Memorial in her hand begins to glow faintly.)
She... Choen Palm... hadn't betrayed me.
Choen's despairing soul had been burning itself all along.
How could anyone do something so cruel...?
Thank you for bringing me this Memorial.
I won't leave her in that madness any longer.
strings.(흑월공주와 함께 초월의 제단으로 가기로 했다.): (You decide to go to the Altar of Transcendence with the Dark Moon Princess.)
strings.(시커먼 어둠 속이다. 몸이 무겁다. 마치 물주머니가 된 것 같다...): (Pitch-black darkness. Your body is heavy, as though it has become a sack of water...)
strings.(누군가의 시점에서 기억을 들여다 보고 있다.): (You are looking into a memory through someone else's eyes.)
strings.(놀랍게도 기억속의 등장인물일 뿐인 소녀가 내 존재를 느끼고 있는 것 같: (Astonishingly, the girl—only a figure in a memory—seems to sense your presence.)
strings.(하지만 어딘지 정신이 뚜렷하지 않아보인다.): (But she does not seem fully conscious.)
strings.(그녀의 몽롱한 정신 저편에, 끔찍한 고통이 도사리고 있는 것이 느껴진다: (Beyond her hazy awareness, you sense terrible pain.)
(The whole side of her head burns, while something cold and wet runs down the back of it...)
Ah! You're awake... Thank goodness. Thank goodness...
Heavens... Who did this to my beautiful child...?
They said... Lady Choen Palm can't ascend to heaven because of me...
strings.(여인은 아무 말도 못한 채 소녀를 끌어안는다.): (Unable to speak, the woman gathers the girl into her arms.)
strings.(...누군가 곁에 있는 것 같아.): (...It feels like someone is beside me.)
strings.(소녀에게 질문을 해볼까?): (Should I try asking the girl something?)
strings.(이름은 없어... 이름을 가져서는 안돼.): (I don't have a name... I'm not allowed to have one.)
strings.(내 존재 자체가 '죄'이기 때문에...): (Because my very existence is a sin...)
strings.(나 때문에 초엔 팜 님이 하늘에 오르시지 못하니까.): (Because Lady Choen Palm cannot ascend to heaven while I exist.)
strings.(초엔 팜 님은 정화의 무녀.): (Lady Choen Palm is the Priestess of Purification.)
strings.(언젠가 하늘의 신부가 되실 분.): (The one who will someday become the Bride of Heaven.)
strings.(성전에 쓰여져 있대.): (They say it's written in the holy scripture.)
strings.(초엔 팜님이 하늘의 신부가 되려면, 인간의 때를 모두 벗고 순수한 몸이: (To become the Bride of Heaven, Lady Choen Palm must shed every human impurity and become pure.)
strings.(그러기 위해 초엔 팜님은 태어날 때 자신의 더러운 것을 분리하여, 따로: (So, when she was born, she separated out her filth and had it born apart from her.)
strings.(그러니까 나는, 존재 자체가 죄.): (That's why my very existence is a sin.)
strings.(열 일곱살이 되면, 초엔 팜 님은 정화의 의식을 치르실 거야.): (When she turns seventeen, Lady Choen Palm will perform the purification ritual.)
strings.(하늘의 신부가 된 초엔 팜 님이 나를 태우시면, 세상에 있는 모든 죄들: (When she becomes the Bride of Heaven and burns me, all the sins of the world will burn with me.)
strings.(그럼 사람들은 모두 착하고 선량한 존재가 되어 하늘님 곁에서 행복하게: (Then everyone will become kind and good, and live happily beside the god of heaven...)
strings.(나로 인해서 초엔 팜 님이 모두를 행복하게 한다면...): (If Lady Choen Palm can make everyone happy because of me...)
strings.(추락하는 느낌과 함께, 메모리얼의 기억 속에서 빠져나왔다.): (With a sensation of falling, you leave the Memorial's memory.)
strings.(이전과 같이, 소녀의 의식 속에 들어와 있다...): (As before, you are inside the girl's consciousness...)
strings.(소녀의 눈 앞에 아름답게 차려입은 또 다른 소녀가 쓰러져 있다.): (Another girl, beautifully dressed, lies on the ground before her.)
strings.(현재보다 조금 어리긴 해도, 초엔 팜 같다.): (She looks a little younger than now, but she appears to be Choen Palm.)
strings.(그녀는 덜덜 떨며 소녀를 올려다보고 있다.): (Trembling, she looks up at the girl.)
strings.세상을 구해주는 거 아니었어?: Weren't you going to save the world?
strings.그런데 왜... 왜 엄마에게 이런 짓을...?: Then why... Why did you do this to Mother...?
strings.(소녀는 품에 검게 탄 무엇인가를 안고 있다.): (The girl cradles something blackened in her arms.)
strings.(까맣게 탄 숯덩이 같다...): (It looks like a charred lump of coal...)
strings.(초엔 팜은 덜덜 떨면서도 불쾌한 표정을 지으며 대답한다.): (Though trembling, Choen Palm answers with an expression of disgust.)
strings.누가 누구의 어미란 말이냐, 이 더러운 것!: Whose mother are you calling her, you filthy thing?!
strings.너같은 것을 낳은 것 만으로도 부족해 도망치게 하려 한 그것의 죄는 넘치: As if giving birth to the likes of you weren't enough, she tried to help you escape! Her sins overflow!
I bestowed my special mercy and “purified” her with my sacred flames... And you, vermin, show no gratitude!
strings.(소녀는 고개를 자기가 온 길을 돌아본다.): (The girl turns to look back the way she came.)
strings.(커다란 장작더미가 검게 타버린채 식은 연기를 뿜어올리고 있다.): (A great pile of firewood, burned black, sends up wisps of cooling smoke.)
It just looks like a wood fire to me...
If this is what sacred fire looks like...
strings.성전에 씌여진 '구원'은 어떤거지?: What is the salvation written of in the scripture?
(Taking advantage of the moment the girl looks away, Choen Palm plunges a knife into her body...)
strings.(하지만 소녀는 아무런 느낌이 없는 것 같다.): (But the girl seems to feel nothing.)
strings....대답해줘. 하늘의 신부님. 우리들의 죄는, 어떻게 정화되는거야?: ...Answer me, Bride of Heaven. How are our sins purified?
strings.그런걸 내가 어떻게 알아!!!: How should I know anything like that?!
strings.이, 인간은 신의 가르침에 따르고, 거역하지 않음을 보이기 위해 사람들은: H-humans follow the god's teachings! For generations, people have served the Bride of Heaven to show that they do not defy him!
strings.성전의 계율에 따라 바르게 살면 어쩌면 너같은 것도 신께서는 자애롭게 거: If you live rightly by the scripture's commandments, perhaps the god will mercifully accept even something like you.
strings.자아, 그러니까 더이상은 죄를 짓지 마. 회... 회개하고 정화의 운명에: Now, stop committing sins. R-repent and submit to your destiny of purification!
strings.초엔 팜님 말고도 하늘의 신부가 있었단 이야기야?: You mean there were Brides of Heaven before you, Lady Choen Palm?
...? Yes. I am the 72nd Bride of Heaven.
Haha... I see... Now I understand.
strings.구원은 인간의 상상, 하늘의 신부는 거짓된 상징. 이런 한심한 이야기가: Salvation is a human fantasy, and the Bride of Heaven a false symbol. This pathetic story has repeated 72 times. Is that it?
strings.72명의 쌍둥이가 그런 이유로 이름을 뺏기고, 유폐되어 살아오고, 열일곱: Seventy-two twins stripped of their names for that reason, kept locked away all their lives, then burned when they turned seventeen...
?! L-let go! How dare you lay a hand on this sacred body, you insolent...!
strings.(소녀가 한손으로 초엔 팜의 목을 잡고 허공으로 들어올린다.): (The girl seizes Choen Palm by the throat with one hand and lifts her into the air.)
Calling something like this a priestess... Believing her two daughters would save the world...
If only you'd believed it to the end, it wouldn't have come to this, Mother...
strings.(소녀의 손에서 불꽃이 일어나 초엔 팜의 얼굴을 태운다.): (Flames rise from the girl's hand and burn Choen Palm's face.)
strings.악! 뜨거워, 뜨거워! 꺄아아아악!!!: Aaah! It's hot! It burns! Aaaaaah!
Yes... You're no Bride of Heaven, no Priestess of Purification.
Perhaps the prophecy was a little mistaken.
strings.꺄악!!! 살려줘, 살려줘!!! 뜨거워, 뜨거워, 뜨거워!!!!: Aaaah! Save me! Save me! It burns, it burns, it burns!
Since you're my sister, I won't let you die.
strings.(소녀는 불타오르는 초엔 팜의 몸을 바닥에 던진다.): (The girl throws Choen Palm's burning body to the ground.)
strings.(순식간에 까맣게 타들어간 초엔 팜은, 그래도 죽지 않고 비명을 지르며: (Blackened in an instant, Choen Palm nevertheless remains alive, screaming and writhing...)
Yes. You won't need that name anymore... I'll take it.
All my life, I've wanted a name.
strings.(초엔 팜이었던 소녀는 이제 말이 아닌 짐승같은 비명으로 운다...): (The girl who was Choen Palm now cries out in animal screams, no longer words...)
...It was probably my name from the beginning.
strings.안녕, 나의 쌍둥이 자매여. '정화의 무녀'로써의 일은 내가 제대로 해보: Goodbye, my twin sister. I'll show you how the work of a Priestess of Purification should be done.
From afar, my sister looked beautiful, sacred... I truly loved her.
strings.(소녀... 아니 초엔 팜이 손을 들자 주변의 모든 것이 타오르기 시작한: (The girl—no, Choen Palm—raises her hand, and everything around her begins to burn.)
(As Choen Palm slowly walks outside, the Memorial's memory begins to end...)
strings.(초엔 팜의 서글픈 웃음소리가 멀어져간다...): (Choen Palm's sorrowful laughter fades into the distance...)
strings.(지평선 끝까지 붉은 황야. 열기를 머금은 아지랑이가 어지럽게 피어난다): (A red wasteland stretches to the horizon. Heat haze rises in dizzying waves.)
strings.(작열하는 열기는 하늘이 아닌 대지로부터... 아니, 그녀에게서 비롯된: (The scorching heat seems to come not from the sky, but from the earth... No, from her.)
strings.(발치에 채이는 돌은 열기에 말랑말랑해져있다.): (Stones at her feet have softened in the heat.)
strings.(비현실적인 풍경 속에, 한 노인이 바위에 걸터앉아 책을 읽고 있다.): (In this unreal landscape, an old man sits on a rock, reading a book.)
Well, well. At last we meet, Priestess of Purification.
...I'm glad to see you too. It's been seven years since I met another person.
strings.호오, 호호... 그런가. 그만큼 무녀님께서 철저하셨다는 이야기가 되겠군: Oh? Hoho... I see. That shows how thorough you've been, Priestess.
After all, everything in the world has burned in the flames of purification over the last sixty years.
strings.그래... 그 말대로, 나는 내 뒤로 아무것도 남기지 않았어. 세상을 돌: Yes... Just as you say, I've left nothing behind me. Around and around the world, burning everything thoroughly.
And that is why I must ask you something.
Oh? What is it? I will answer what I can.
strings.당신은 하늘님인가?: Are you the god of heaven?
strings.(초엔 팜을 바라보던 노인은 이거참 하고 뺨을 긁는다.): (The old man looks at Choen Palm, then scratches his cheek as if to say, “Oh dear.”)
strings.(갑자기 노인에게서 숨이 막힐듯한 존재감이 느껴진다...): (Suddenly, a suffocating presence emanates from the old man...)
strings.(초엔 팜은 당장에라도 엎드려 노인에게 절하고 싶은 충동을 온 몸에 힘을: (Choen Palm braces her whole body against the urge to throw herself down and bow to him.)
strings....대답해. 내게 무슨 짓을 한거지?: ...Answer me. What have you done to me?
strings.호오...? 무녀님께서는 무슨 말을 하고 싶으신지?: Oh...? What are you trying to say, Priestess?
strings.그대는 그대가 타고난 인생 속에서 스스로의 의지로 선택을 하고, 지금까지: Have you not lived the life into which you were born, making choices of your own free will, right up to this moment?
strings.말 장난 하지 말아!: Don't play word games with me!
strings.그래, 언니가 어머니를... 태운.... 날, 힘이 눈을 뜨고, 분노가: Yes. On the day my sister... burned... Mother, my power awoke, and I did what my anger demanded...
strings.하지만... 지금 이건 뭐야? 육십년이나 전 세계를 돌며 눈에 보이는 모: But... what is this now? Sixty years roaming the world, destroying everything I saw... Why? I never wanted that!
No, even on that first day... I... never... wanted... to kill... anyone!
Yes... How pitiful... But you did.
strings.성전에 이르길, \"하늘의 신부가 세상을 정화하여, 모든 죄는 사해지리라: As the scripture says, “The Bride of Heaven shall purify the world, and all sins shall be forgiven.”
Indeed. Your life was prepared for that purpose from the beginning.
strings.무슨... 헛소리를 하는거야?! 모두가 죽어버렸는데, 죄를 사함은 뭐고,: What... nonsense is this?! Everyone is dead! What forgiveness? What happiness? What do you mean, the words of scripture?!
strings.이상해, 왜 모두가 죽어야 했던거야? 왜 이런걸 나에게 시켰어, 왜? 왜: It's wrong. Why did everyone have to die? Why did you make me do this? Why? Why?! WHY?!
strings.(노인은 초엔팜의 비명같은 부르짖음을 듣고 잠시 침묵하더니, 이내 웃기: (The old man listens to Choen Palm's anguished cries, falls silent for a moment, then begins to laugh.)
strings.(입가가 초승달처럼 크게 휘어지며, \"이히히\" 하고 웃는 노인의 웃음: (His mouth curves wide as a crescent moon. The old man's “hee-hee” laugh is the most horrifying thing Choen Palm has ever seen...)
strings.오래되어 더럽고 낡은 세상을 정화했으니, 이제 새로운 세상을 만들어야겠지:
Now that the old, filthy, worn-out world is purified, we must create a new one, mustn't we?
It has always been this way.
strings.그렇지, 세계를 아무리 훌륭하게 가꾸어도, 언젠가는 썩고, 지저분해지게: Yes. However beautifully I cultivate a world, it eventually rots and grows dirty.
strings.몇번 그런 일을 겪은 뒤, 아예 깨끗하게 정리할 수 있도록 규칙을 정한거: After seeing it happen a few times, I established a rule so I could simply wipe it clean.
strings.이제 내가 그대의 피와 살을 비료로 새로운 세상을 빚으면, 그대의 시신을: Now I shall use your flesh and blood as fertilizer to shape a new world. A world that worships your corpse as its Earth Mother will be born.
strings.한동안 이 지상에 낙원이 생기고.... 인간이 지혜를 얻고 타락하면 서서: For a time, paradise will exist upon this earth... Then humans will gain wisdom and become corrupt. Gradually, the new world will become an old one and approach its end.
strings.그런 세상의 흥망성쇠를 지켜보는게 말이지, 의외겠지만, 지루하지가 않다네: Watching worlds rise and fall like that... You might find it surprising, but it never grows dull! Like a storybook whose tales spring up endlessly from a well.
strings.(노인의 웃음을 바라보며 초엔 팜은 망연자실한다.): (Choen Palm stares at the old man's smile, utterly stunned.)
strings.(초엔 팜의 시야가 붉게 변하고, 전신에서 하늘에 닿을듯한 거대한 불꽃이: (Choen Palm's vision turns red. Enormous flames erupt from her body, seemingly reaching the sky.)
(In an instant, the flames fill the horizon and surge toward the old man like a vast tidal wave.)
strings.(천천히 불꽃이 가라앉고, 노인은 상처 하나 없이 그대로 서 있다.): (The flames slowly subside. The old man stands untouched, without a single wound.)
strings.(노인은 한 손에 초엔 팜의 목을, 다른 손엔 무언가 검고 꿈틀거리는 것: (In one hand, he holds Choen Palm by the throat. In the other, he grips something black and writhing.)
strings.호호오... 역시 이럴 것 같더라니만. 역시 무녀님은 나의 신부가 될 생: Hoho... Just as I suspected. You have no intention of becoming my bride, do you, Priestess?
That's quite all right. I am merciful. I will gladly honor the wishes of my creation.
strings.사실 신에게 신부가 무슨 소용이겠나. 여기... 그대의 '저주'를 받은: What use does a god have for a bride, anyway? Here... I'll use this thing, bearing your curse, as a seedbed for life.
strings.(초엔 팜은 노인의 손에 들린채 자신의 옆에서 끽끽 소리를 내는 검은 것: (Hanging from the old man's hand, Choen Palm thinks she has seen the black, squealing thing beside her somewhere before.)
Then... for the sake of the new world, let us remove every remnant of the old.
As it happens, I know a place perfectly suited to you, Priestess.
strings.터무니 없는 혼돈과 어둠의 힘이 세상을 덮치는 바람에, 신들마저 도망쳐버: A world overwhelmed by outrageous chaos and darkness, so much so that even its gods fled.
strings.아마 멸망이 머지 않은 것 같고, 어둠의 노예로 살아가는 것은 그리 쾌적: Its destruction is probably near, and life as a slave of darkness will hardly be pleasant... Still, my new world has no need for someone as boring as you. It can't be helped. Farewell!
strings.(노인의 목소리가 멀어져가며, 초엔 팜은 자신이 어딘가로 빨려들어간다는: (As the old man's voice recedes, Choen Palm feels herself being pulled somewhere.)
strings.(세상의 모든 것이, 그저 그자를 위한 광대놀음일 뿐이었어.): (Everything in the world was only a farce staged for him.)
strings.(나의 '모든 것'이, 겨우 그런걸 위한 거였어...?): (Everything I was... existed only for that...?)
strings.(흐려져가는 의식속에, 초엔팜은 한가지 생각을 반복한다.): (As her consciousness fades, Choen Palm repeats a single thought.)
strings.(분노가 그녀의 정신을 완전히 태우고, 어둠이 그녀를 받아들인다...): (Anger burns away her mind completely, and darkness receives her...)
strings.이 곳이 초월의 제단?: So this is the Altar of Transcendence?
Hmph. The view is lovely, but for such a grand name, there's nothing here.
Because ornament has no meaning in this place.
strings.(제단의 중심부, 카즈노가 서 있다.): (Kazno stands at the center of the altar.)
strings.(카즈노의 뒤에는 초엔 팜이 허공에 매달려있다.): (Behind him, Choen Palm hangs suspended in the air.)
strings.(허공에서 나타난 사슬이 그녀의 몸을 구속하고 있다.): (Chains emerging from empty space bind her body.)
strings.오랜만이군, 흑월공주, 마법사, 그리고... 그쪽은 아르카디아에서 만났었: It's been a while, Dark Moon Princess, Mage... And you, we met in Arcadia.
strings.당황스러워보이는군. 내가 이곳에 있는 것이 이상한가?: You look confused. Is it strange to find me here?
Yes... It is an odd place for a chance meeting and a pleasant chat...
strings.흠, 마왕의 힘을 가진 그녀가 세계를 불태우는 것을 막기 위함이라면 알겠: Hmm. Would it help if I said I was stopping her from burning the world with the Demon King's power?
So it was her... The one who appeared beside the Demon King that day.
Yes. The bird of flame that appeared then was this Choen Palm.
strings.......그래서, 초엔을 막는 것과 당신들이 여기 있는건 무슨 관계가: ...Then what does stopping Choen have to do with the two of you being here?
Choen Palm had a reason to come here.
strings.이 곳이야말로 그녀의 정신을 구속한 마왕의 혼을 떼어낼 최적의 장소이니까: This was the ideal place to remove the Demon King's soul that was binding her mind.
strings.2. 마왕의 혼: 2. Ask about the Demon King's soul.
strings.그날, 이리스가 가한 필살의 일격에 의해 마왕이 약해진 틈을 타 초엔 팜: That day, Choen Palm took advantage of the moment Iris's killing blow weakened the Demon King and seized his body. The Tyr souls that made up his soul scattered the instant they were separated from him.
strings.방해할 것은 아무것도 없는 것 처럼 보였고, 그녀는 새롭게 얻은 힘을: Nothing seemed able to hinder her. She wielded her new power freely, defeated Iris's party, and forced the powerful beings trying to cross from other dimensions back into their own worlds.
strings.자신이 만들어낸 '인형'이 그녀를 방해하리라고는 꿈에도 생각하지 못했을: She could never have imagined that the doll she created would stand in her way.
strings.게네페는 이리스를 유인하고, 절망을 주기 위해 초엔팜이 만든 '인형' 이: Genepe was a doll Choen Palm created to lure Iris in and plunge her into despair.
But as the Dark Moon Princess and Siam both witnessed...
The boy protected Iris from Choen Palm's attack... and vanished.
strings.너무나 데르족을, 이리스를 닮게 만들었기에, 세상을 떠돌던 데르족의 영혼: She had made him so much like the Tyr, so much like Iris... Perhaps a wandering Tyr soul came to dwell within him.
In any case, that was not the only miracle Genepe accomplished.
strings.무정하게도 허공에 흩어져야 했을 마왕의 혼 중 상당수가, 게네페의 '혼': Many of the souls that had formed the Demon King, which should have scattered mercilessly into the void, gathered around Genepe's soul... and lodged themselves within Choen Palm's mind.
Choen Palm could no longer properly wield the Demon King's power she had finally obtained. Though only a portion, those souls had once formed his soul. They drove her mind to the brink of destruction.
That is why Choen Palm had to come here.
strings.4. 초월의 제단: 4. Ask about the Altar of Transcendence.
I said earlier that ornament has no meaning here.
strings.이 곳이야말로 데르족이 자신들의 혼을 바쳐 마왕을 탄생시킨, 말 그대로: This was, quite literally, the altar where the Tyr offered their souls and gave birth to the Demon King.
strings.이 곳에서라면, 자신의 정신에 융합한 데르족의 혼을 분리해내는 것도 가능: Choen Palm believed that here she could separate the Tyr souls fused with her mind. And indeed, she did.
She simply didn't expect me to capture her.
strings.당신... 아가슈라잖아?: You... You're an Agasura, aren't you?
...Honestly, you and Choen fooled us so thoroughly, all this time.
...I've heard the Agasura have three leaders.
strings.카즈노 당신도 그 셋 중 하나인거지?: You're one of them, aren't you, Kazno?
strings.동족이잖아? 마왕과의 싸움에서도 처음부터 손발을 맞춘거 아니었어?: She's one of your own. You were working together from the start, even in the battle with the Demon King, weren't you?
strings.그렇게도 귀여워하던 이리스를, 처음부터 배신할 생각이었겠지?: You intended to betray Iris from the beginning, even though you acted so fond of her.
strings.(가벼운 태도로 이야기를 늘어놓던 카즈노가 처음으로 입을 다문다.): (For the first time, Kazno's easygoing stream of words stops.)
strings.그런 당신이 왜 이제와서, 초엔과 적대하는거지?: Then why are you turning against Choen now?
...Yes. We were. What we wanted was to break free of the chains that bound us.
strings.자유! 숙명에 사로잡힌 동족들에게 자유를 주고 싶었다!: Freedom! I wanted freedom for my people, prisoners of their destiny!
Even if that freedom was false...
But Choen Palm had no intention of stopping there.
What she wanted was to fill the entire world with flame.
strings.그래, 마계 깊은 곳에 존재하는 화염의 도시, 메기도의 참상을 이 세계에: Yes, as though she wished to recreate here the horrors of Megiddo, the city of flame deep in the Demon Realm...
strings.그런 그녀에게 마왕의 힘을 넘길 수 있었을 것 같나?: Do you think I could let her have the Demon King's power in that state?
strings.그럴리가! 초엔은, 아냐, 초엔은 그런 짓 만은 결코 하지 않아. 그럴: Impossible! Choen... No, Choen would never do that. She couldn't!
You've had a chance to understand her better, have you, Princess?
strings.뭐... 일단, 동감이다. 초엔 팜은 적에게는 잔혹한 여자지만, 그정도로: Well... for the moment, I agree. Choen Palm is cruel to her enemies, but she was never that mad.
strings.발할라에서 만난 그녀는 어땠나? 말해봐 공주. 어떻게 느꼈지? 배신감에: What was she like when you met her in Valhalla? Tell me, Princess. What did you feel? Did betrayal make you tremble with rage?
...Yes. I thought she'd betrayed me. I resented her so much.
strings.(이런건 초엔이 아니야, 초엔일 수가 없어...!): (This isn't Choen. It can't be Choen...!)
I thought it was only a vain hope born of weakness...
strings....그래서? 지금은 어떻게 생각하지?: ...And now? What do you think now?
...When you fall into the abyss, you become the abyss itself.
strings.그녀 안에 있는 불꽃의 씨앗은, 누군가의 마지막 유흥거리가 아니었을까?: Perhaps the seed of flame within her was someone's final source of amusement.
strings....대저, 그런 것이지, 세상에 죄인으로 칭해지는 이들 중 얼마나 많은: ...Such is the way of things. How many of those the world calls sinners were ever given a choice?
strings.운명이 특별히 누군가에게 잔혹한데다, 사악하기까지 한 것은, 그리 특별한: There is nothing especially unusual about fate being cruel to someone... or even downright evil.
But I still have to ask.
strings.저 친구는 알겠어. 이리스를 찾을 수 있을까 하는 희망에 여기까지 온 거: I understand our friend here. They came all this way hoping to find Iris.
But you, Dark Moon Princess... You came for the woman before us, not Iris.
strings.이제 어떻게 할 생각이지? 무엇을 하고 싶나?: What will you do now? What is it you want?
strings.(흑월공주는 잠시 멈칫했지만, 망설이지 않고 바로 대답한다.): (The Dark Moon Princess pauses for a moment, then answers without hesitation.)
I came here to save Choen. We're going back to Aoich together.
Sigh... I knew you'd say that.
strings.(머리를 긁적이는 카즈노 뒤에서 큭큭거리는 웃음소리가 들려온다.): (A quiet, mocking laugh comes from behind Kazno as he scratches his head.)
Honestly. This girl hasn't changed a bit.
strings.함께, 아오이치로 돌아가자. 응...?: Let's go back to Aoich together. Please...?
You foolish girl... Don't be ridiculous.
The kind Choen you knew never existed, Princess.
strings.공주 앞에 있는건 새벽의 계명성, 새로운 시대를 위해 위선과 그릇된 것을: The woman before you is the morning star of dawn. I live to burn away hypocrisy and corruption for a new age, and return all things to nothingness.
Though this traitor made me fail at the final hurdle...
Hmph... Time is on my side, regardless. I will fulfill my mission.
No. Choen, those aren't your words.
strings.너를 여기까지 오게 한, 그 자가 네 운명을 아직도 희롱하고 있어!: The one who brought you to this point is still toying with your fate!
strings.제발... 눈을 떠, 초엔, 마음 속의 증오에 지지 마!: Please... Open your eyes, Choen. Don't let the hatred in your heart defeat you!
What... What are you talking about...?
strings.닥쳐, 닥쳐닥쳐닥쳐!!! 시끄러워!!! 가까이 와, 당장 너부터 불태워버: Shut up! Shut up, shut up, shut up!!! Be quiet!!! Come closer! I'll burn you first, right here and now!!!
strings.(가만히 있던 카즈노가 앞으로 한걸음 내딛었다.): (Kazno, who has been standing quietly, takes a step forward.)
strings.(갑자기 카즈노에게서 강렬한 기운이 솟아나기 시작한다.): (A powerful aura suddenly begins to rise from him.)
strings.초엔 팜양은 이렇게 말하고 계시지만, 흑월공주님께서는 물러설 생각이 없으: Miss Choen Palm has made her position clear, but I suppose Her Highness has no intention of backing down.
strings....카즈노... 무슨 말을 하려는거야?: ...Kazno... What are you trying to say?
strings.(어느새 카즈노가 꺼내든 검이, 흑월공주의 가슴에 꽂혀있다.): (Before I can react, the sword Kazno has drawn is buried in the Dark Moon Princess's chest.)
strings.(흑월공주는 경직되어 무너지듯 쓰러진다.): (The Dark Moon Princess stiffens, then crumples to the ground.)
Best to eliminate a threat as soon as it appears.
She kept saying she'd free you. I had no choice.
I have no desire to see you destroy the world.
strings.왜 그러지? 안색이 안 좋으시군. 별로 중요한 일도 아니지 않나?: What's wrong? You look pale. It hardly matters, does it?
strings.%s, 피가 흐르는게 심상치 않소. 이대로 두면 큰일이 일어날거요...!: %s, she's losing far too much blood. If we leave her like this, something terrible will happen...!
strings.(흑월공주를 구해야 한다!): (I have to save the Dark Moon Princess!)
Hey, weren't you listening just now? Not the sharpest, are you?
strings.그럼 할 수 없지... 한번 해볼까, 친구?: Well, if that's how it is... Shall we have a go, my friend?
strings.(한순간에 카즈노의 모습이 공기 중으로 투명해지며, 위압적인 아가슈라의: (In an instant, Kazno fades into the air, and a menacing Agasura appears in his place!)
strings.어이, 아가씨. 기분이 안 좋으신 것 같군 그래?: Hey, young lady. You don't look very happy.
strings.(초엔팜은 진땀을 흘리며 괴로워하고 있다.): (Choen Palm is drenched in a cold sweat, writhing in pain.)
strings.(그녀는 이를 갈며 카즈노를 노려본다.): (She grits her teeth and glares at Kazno.)
strings.(흑월공주가 가냘픈 목소리를 낸다.): (The Dark Moon Princess speaks in a faint voice.)
strings.(그녀는 자신의 피로 만들어진 웅덩이에 쓰러져 있다...): (She lies in a pool of her own blood...)
The cherry trees... By... the lake...
Oh dear... Is she dead? She must have lost too much blood.
strings.왜 화를 내는거지, 초엔 팜? 아무래도 상관없는 여자아이 하나가 죽었을: Why are you angry, Choen Palm? A girl who means nothing to you has died. That's all.
strings.세상을 전부 태워 정화하고, 모든걸 무로 돌리는 것 아니었나?: Weren't you going to purify the whole world with fire, and return everything to nothingness?
A mortal destined to die has died. Nothing remarkable about that.
strings.(초엔팜에게서 무엇인가가 튕겨져 나오고 있다.): (Something is being driven out of Choen Palm.)
strings.(눈에는 보이지 않지만, 그녀의 몸을 몇겹으로 둘러싸고 있던 무엇인가가: (I cannot see it, but something wrapped around her body in layer upon layer is disappearing.)
strings.(마치 그녀의 몸을 칭칭 얽어매고 있던 사슬이 끊어지는 것만 같다.): (It is as though the chains binding her tight are snapping apart.)
You foolish girl... You didn't have to do this.
Some bodyguard I turned out to be.
strings.(초엔팜의 이마의 문양이 달아오르며 그녀의 몸이 빛나기 시작한다): (The mark on Choen Palm's forehead burns bright, and her body begins to glow.)
...My "wish"... is for the Dark Moon Princess to live again.
Darkness. I'll give you my life in payment for that wish. Take it.
strings.흑월공주가 치를 대가는 내가 정하지... 그녀의 나에 대한 '기억'을 가: I will decide the price the Dark Moon Princess pays... Take her 'memories' of me.
strings.('아가슈라의 소원'의 대가를 직접 정한다고? ...그녀가 '마왕'이 되: (She can set the price of an 'Agasura's wish' herself? ...Did becoming the 'Demon King' allow her to break some of the Agasura's rules?)
strings.카즈노. 이 빌어먹을 인간. 고맙다는 말은 바라지 않겠지?: Kazno. You bastard. Don't expect me to thank you.
strings.이미 죽어있는 목숨을 억지로 이어붙이고 있는 주제에, 무얼 할 생각인지: You're clinging to a life that's already ended. I don't know what you hope to accomplish, but give it your best shot...
strings.(뭐라고... 역시 나와 계약할때 그의 목숨은....): (What...? Then when he made the contract with me, his life was already...)
...I think you already gave me what I truly wanted, Princess.
Forget about someone like me. Live a happy life.
strings.(한 순간, 눈을 뜰 수 없을 정도로 초엔팜의 몸이 밝게 빛난다.): (For an instant, Choen Palm's body shines so brightly that I cannot keep my eyes open.)
...Hehehe... What a wretched life it was.
...Choen Palm... It seems she returned to her true self at the very end.
strings.처음부터 이렇게 되기를 원했던 것 아닌가, 카즈노?: Isn't this what you wanted all along, Kazno?
strings.그녀를 구원하고 싶었던 것이오?: Did you want to save her?
Who knows...? Do I look like such a good man?
She's gone, so I've achieved my objective, at any rate.
strings.(카즈노의 손에서 작은 빛의 조각같은 것이 떠오른다.): (Something like a tiny shard of light rises from Kazno's hand.)
strings.(힘없이 빛나는 그것은 공기를 둥실 떠오르더니 나한테 다가온다.): (Glowing faintly, it drifts through the air toward me.)
strings.(그리고 가까이 다가와 투명해지더니 사라진다.): (As it draws near, it becomes transparent and disappears.)
strings.(가슴 안에 무언가 작고 따뜻한 것이 들어왔다...): (Something small and warm has entered my chest...)
It's part of the fragments of Tyr souls that were tormenting Choen Palm.
strings.거의 힘을 잃어 얼마 안 있어 사라질 것 같다만, 어딘가 쓰임새가 있을지: They've lost almost all their strength and will probably fade soon. Still, they may be of some use.
I'm glad I can say goodbye one last time.
...The darkness staining my body has been growing stronger.
When the barrier over this land broke, time began moving for me again.
strings.결국은 뇨르드나, 바나헤임의 모든 생명들과 마찬가지로, 어둠의 일부가 될: In the end, I am destined to become part of the darkness, just like Njord and every other living thing in Vanaheim.
...Before that happens, I intend to end things myself, at least.
strings.지금의 모습 그대로 어둠의 존재가 되면, 세상에 지나치게 위협적인 존재가: If I become a creature of darkness with the power I have now, I would pose too great a threat to the world.
strings.(데르는 잠시 침묵하더니, 조금 망설이다가 말을 꺼낸다.): (Tyr falls silent for a moment, then speaks hesitantly.)
...No matter how far I wandered through this world in my dreams, I was always alone.
I was happy to meet you at the end of that lonely dream. Thank you.
strings.(카즈노에게 받은 빛의 조각이, 가슴 속에서 무언가를 호소한다.): (The shard of light Kazno gave me seems to plead for something within my chest.)
Let us part... while we can still do so with a smile.
I... cannot hold on any longer.
strings.내가 타락하는 모습을... 보여주고 싶지 않단 말이야, 모르겠어?: I don't want you to see me fall... Don't you understand?
Please... I cannot end this while you're here...
strings.(하지만 그녀를 절대 두고 가서는 안된다는 생각이 든다.): (But I feel that I absolutely must not leave her.)
strings.(데르의 몸을 어둠의 줄기가 타고 올라오기 시작한다.): (Tendrils of darkness begin creeping up Tyr's body.)
strings.그대의 따뜻한 마음이 잔혹한 것이 될 수 있음을... 왜 모르지?: Why can't you see... that your kindness can be cruel?
strings....아아... 그대의 혼이 느껴져, 무척이나... 감미로운 빛을 띄고: ...Ahh... I can feel your soul. Its light is so... sweet...
strings....내가 지금 무슨 소리를... 그대는 나의 원죄가 될 셈인가?: ...What am I saying...? Do you intend to become my original sin?
I have to drive you away while I still have my senses...
strings.어서, 도망치도록 해! 그렇지 않으면 내가 쫓아내겠어!: Run, now! Or I will force you out!
I hope you find my descendant, as you wish.
But please do not take too many risks.
strings.훗... 이런 곳까지 찾아온 그대에게 이런 말 해봤자 의미가 없겠지?: Heh... Little point in saying that to someone who came all the way here, is there?
May light, all benevolent beings, and a little luck watch over your path...
strings.(데르는 부드럽게 미소지으며 작별을 고한다.): (Tyr says farewell with a gentle smile.)
strings.(손을 흔들어주는 그녀를 뒤로하고 숲을 나선다.): (I leave the forest as she waves goodbye behind me.)
(I sense a bright, warm light swelling behind my back, then fading away.)
strings.(그와 동시에, 카즈노에게 받은 빛의 조각이 가슴 속에서 사라졌다.): (At the same moment, the shard of light Kazno gave me vanishes from my chest.)
strings.(빛의 조각이 비명을 지르듯, 불이 꺼지듯, 훅 하고 단숨에 사라지자,: (It goes out in an instant, like a cry cut short or a flame snuffed out, leaving an emptiness in my chest.)
strings.(끝까지 뒤돌아보지 않고 숲을 나서기로 했다.): (I decide to leave the forest without looking back.)
...I have never seen a warrior like you.
I was once a teacher to my entire people... Yet I am no match for you.
strings.왜, 내 부탁을 들어주지 않는거지?: Why won't you honor my request?
Only the slightest touch of darkness has changed me this much.
strings.이런 모습, 절대 보여주고 싶지 않았는데... 어째서 내게 수치를 주는거: I never wanted you to see me like this... Why must you shame me?
strings.(갑자기, 몸 속에서 카즈노가 준 빛의 조각이 일렁이기 시작한다.): (Suddenly, the shard of light Kazno gave me begins to stir inside me.)
strings.(크게 부풀어오른 빛의 조각이, 내 몸에서 분리된다.): (The shard swells brightly and separates from my body.)
strings.(그리고 점차 사람의 형태를 갖추기 시작한다.): (It slowly begins to take on a human form.)
strings.(어둠이 걷혀나가고 그녀의 모습이 원래대로 돌아온다.): (The darkness clears, and she returns to her original form.)
Ahh, ahhh... My baby, my little baby...
I... kept looking for you, Mom.
strings.그랬구나, 미안해, 미안해...!: You did... I'm sorry. I'm so sorry...!
I missed you too... Mommy missed you too.
Yes... It's been so long. Far too long...
But I saw so many things.
I helped a girl who looked like you, Mom.
strings.그리고, 마왕이 없는 세상은 햇살이 정말 아름다워요. 아아, 할 이야기가: And the sunlight is so beautiful in a world without the Demon King. Oh, I have so much to tell you...!
Yes, tell me. Tell me everything. Mommy's listening.
strings.(데르와 게네페의 모습이 천천히 빛속에서 사라져간다.): (Tyr and Genepe slowly fade into the light.)
strings.(얼핏, 두사람이 이쪽을 보며 고개를 끄덕인 것 같다.): (For a moment, they seem to look my way and nod.)
strings.(그녀의 눈물 섞인 웃음소리를 마지막으로, 둘은 완전히 사라진다.): (With the last sound of her tearful laughter, they vanish completely.)
strings.(데르가 외로움에 꿈꾸었던 추억의 숲, 바나헤임만이 남겨졌다.): (Only Vanaheim remains: the forest of memories Tyr dreamed of in her loneliness.)
